purpose: Ordered golden case list. Case file shape: {files: {relpath: body}, expected_rows: [...]} -- bodies are JSON-encoded strings. An optional top-level full_output_cap_bytes (a test-only override of the producer's full-output cap, applied by the corpus consumers' case_cap block) lets a case exercise an omission with a small fixture. expected_rows are canonical normalised rows (derived ids incl., the normalised_out columns excluded, None columns dropped), sorted by table then event_id. golden_digest = sha256 over, for each case in this order, the case basename, a newline and json.dumps(expected_rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False), newline-joined.
